card.text: A red giant measured at 57 milliarcseconds: wider, its observers concluded, than any star but the Sun.

sources.label: Bedding et al. (1997), MNRAS 286, 957
sources.quote: We find the angular diameter of R Doradus to be 57 +/- 5 mas, exceeding that of Betelgeuse and implying that R Dor is larger in apparent size than every star except the Sun.

introduction.text: ALMA resolved its surface in 2023: a 60 milliarcsecond disc, mottled by convection that turns over in about a month.

sources.label: Vlemmings et al. (2024), Nature 633, 323
sources.quote: The images reveal a stellar disc with prominent small scale features that provide the structure and motions of convection on the stellar surface.

alma.title: ALMA at 338 gigahertz
alma.summary: The photosphere in millimetre waves, ten resolution elements across. Single convective cells are smaller than the beam.

shape.title: Sphere of the published radius
shape.summary: A sphere at the published size in neutral gray, for comparison with the image.

color.title: Photosphere colour
color.summary: The colour of a measured spectrum of the star. No surface picture or edge darkening is measured.
